question_text: How many distinct object_id values were tracked at Gate_MainEntrance across all entry/exit events on 2025-12-08 (UTC)?

gold.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT object_id) AS distinct_objects FROM events WHERE camera_location = 'Gate_MainEntrance' AND event_type IN ('person_entry','person_exit','car_entry','car_exit') AND timestamp_utc >= '2025-12-08T00:00:00Z' AND timestamp_utc < '2025-12-09T00:00:00Z'

metadata.note: Tests COUNT(DISTINCT object_id) — distinct tracked objects.
